survey: A flying saucer seen from above, about three-quarters, floating against a yellow ring background with no ground plane. Main parts: (1) The saucer body is a wide, shallow brushed-metal cone. Its outline is an ellipse tilted slightly, rising from left to right, so the top face is clearly visible. (2) A dark rounded bumper runs around the rim. It looks thicker at the front and thinner at the back, as it should when seen from above. (3) Orange light bulbs sit on the bumper. The front ones (bottom centre) are the largest and most widely spaced. Toward the back and the left and right ends they get smaller and closer together, so they follow the curve of the rim ellipse. (4) A metal collar ring sits on top of the cone, a little behind the centre, which fits because it is raised on the cone's peak. Its ellipse is about as narrow and tilted at about the same angle as the rim ellipse. (5) A green glass dome sits inside the collar. Its outline is a smooth hemisphere and its base matches the collar ellipse. Highlights on the dome, cone and bumper agree on one light source and one viewpoint. Because the saucer floats, there is no ground contact to check.
